# Feature: Skill Progression v2 as the only supported model

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-03 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent

Remove all Skill Progression legacy compatibility. V2 provenance is the only canonical skill state. Every SagaDrive-core character must have complete V2 data (7 free / 2 background / 1 archetype, background pool of 4, one background specialization, filled development slots). Incomplete data fails persistence — never “legacy”. No productive legacy character data exists; no migration or backfill.

Roadmap: Skill Progression v2 post-#101 — fail-closed only.

## Preconditions

- Skill Progression v2 (#89/#90/#91) and hardening (#101) are on `main`.
- Partial update guard from #101 remains: skills/profile/attributes/level/ruleset_key → load once, merge, validate full state, then write.
- Migration 014 unchanged. No character backfill.

## Happy Path

- [ ] Complete V2 start build (7 free + 2 background + 1 archetype + background spec) persists and reloads with the same ranks.
- [ ] Archetype key and archetype training skill are mandatory; training skill must belong to the archetype.
- [ ] Final ranks always come from `resolveSagaDriveSkillRanksSafe` (never stored-final fallback).
- [ ] Save payload contains complete V2 sources and does not emit `skillProvenanceStatus` or `legacy-unresolved`.
- [ ] Editor and skills panel show no legacy character hint.

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Missing archetype, missing archetype training skill, or training skill outside the archetype → persistence FAIL.
- [ ] Incomplete start sources (missing free / background / archetype point) → FAIL.
- [ ] Background pool size ≠ 4, duplicates, missing/unbound background spec → FAIL.
- [ ] Unfilled unlocked development slots, two decisions on one level, chronological spec prerequisite miss → FAIL.
- [ ] Final skills ≠ provenance-derived skills → FAIL.
- [ ] Partial updates (skills-only, profile-only, level-only) validate merged state and fail closed.
- [ ] Completely missing provenance, `trainedSkills`-only, or partial V2 data → FAIL (never accepted as legacy).
- [ ] Normalization does not invent a valid build from incomplete input; `trainedSkills` is derived from `backgroundSkillPoints` only.

## Regression

- [ ] #101 partial-update merge-and-validate path unchanged in the repository.
- [ ] Architecture boundary check passes (no new `src/modules/**` implementation).
- [ ] Character editor create/save/reload E2E still works for a complete V2 character.

## Assumptions

- Option A: `skillProvenanceStatus` is removed from the canonical domain/persistence contract. Existing JSONB keys are ignored on read and not written on save; no SQL migration.
- `background.trainedSkills` remains a derived display/compatibility array from `backgroundSkillPoints`, never a source of truth.
- No balance change, no new dependency, no UI redesign.
